# Titan Fine

> > Titan Fine is a manufacturer and exporter of disposable protective gloves including nitrile, latex, and vinyl gloves for medical, industrial, and food service applications.

The company specializes in wholesale and bulk nitrile disposable gloves made from acrylonitrile butadiene rubber (NBR), along with natural rubber latex and PVC vinyl alternatives. Titan Fine provides comprehensive guidance on glove selection, sizing, material comparisons, and industry standards compliance for healthcare PPE and industrial protective equipment.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile gloves (NBR/acrylonitrile butadiene)
- Latex gloves (natural rubber)
- Vinyl gloves (PVC/polyvinyl chloride)
- Medical and exam gloves
- Disposable protective equipment
- Chemical resistance
- Puncture resistance
- Healthcare PPE
- Industrial gloves
- Glove material comparisons
- FDA and EN standards compliance
- Glove thickness and sizing
- COVID-19 protective equipment
- Food service gloves
